name: Prime Nucleate Ein

stealth.details: (master) to recognize Ein's gem for what it is

disable: DC 38 Arcana check, DC 38 Nature check, DC 38 Occult check, or DC 38 Religion check once to break an adjacent beam's magical connection with Death, followed by a DC 40 Athletics check, DC 40 Crafting check, or DC 40 Thievery check check to reposition an adjacent lens so that the beam it reflects strikes Ein. Once a beam strikes Ein's body, she loses one action, and the beam follows her wherever she moves. When four beams are focused on Ein, her light body overloads and is destroyed, ending her assault.
reset: If Ein destroys the intruders, she retrieves Death, places him in a hard-light cocoon at the center of the temple, and then proceeds to return any repositioned lenses to their original alignment, trapping him once more. She then returns to her gem form and resumes her orbit around the chamber.
routine: (4 actions) If Ein doesn't begin her turn within range of at least one enemy, she uses her first action to Fly into range, her next two actions to use Shattering Shriek (if available), and any remaining actions to use Ein's Assault or Bonds of Light, prioritizing creatures attempting to tamper with the lenses.

items.name: Awaken
items.text:
Trigger Death's connection with at least two of the beams is broken

---
Effect Ein projects herself a Gargantuan hard-light body resembling an enormous scarab beetle, which appears in the center of the temple. The hazard then rolls initiative.

items.name: Bonds of Light
items.text:
Frequency once per round

---
Effect Ein projects shackles of hardlight at a single creature within 30 feet, binding them to the nearest surface. The target must attempt a DC 38 Reflex save save or become Immobilized (escape dc=40). The shackles can be destroyed by any effect capable of destroying or damaging force constructs. Ein can release a shackled creature as a free action, and for each creature currently shackled, the maximum number of actions she can spend on her Ein's Assault ability decreases by 1.

items.name: Ein's Assault
items.text:
1 to 3

Frequency once per round

---
Effect Ein projects a horde of insectile hard-light constructs in a 20-foot burst within 30 feet (DC 38 basic Reflex save save), which swarm over creatures in the area in a biting, tearing cloud. The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 2d8+2 force damage

2 4d8+14 force damage

3 6d8+14 force damage

items.name: Shattering Shriek
items.text:
Frequency once per round

---
Effect Ein Flies to the center of the temple and emits a piercing wail, detonating a swath of crystals in a storm of razor-sharp fragments. All creatures within 10 feet of a wall take 10d6 piercing damage (DC 43 basic Reflex save save), and all creatures in a 10-foot emanation around Ein take 10d6 sonic damage (DC 43 basic Fortitude save save), becoming permanently Deafened on a critical failure. Ein can't use Shattering Shriek again for 1d4 rounds.

items.name: No Escape
items.text:
Trigger Death is freed from his bonds

---
Effect Ein screams in fury, projecting an impenetrable hard-light barrier across the entrance to the temple, sealing all intruders inside.

text: Ein uses her ability to project constructs of hardlight to harry intruders, hoping to slay them before they can free Death.
